name: Contrail — Flight Tracker
description: A day-to-night product site for Contrail, a flight tracker that tells you first: bold Inter on a golden-ratio scale with tight negative tracking, one amber accent, violet night glow and soft layered shadows. A pinned hero walks one trip through four phases on a live phone (a real flying map, an airport diagram with a taxiing plane, the arrival screen, the passport) while notifications around it light up and the page turns to night; a manifesto that lights word by word; a bento of working mockups (a glowing delay prediction, the inbound aircraft, tower advisories, a filling lock screen, a forecast); a sideways-pinned timeline of a delay seen coming; a flight importer that really parses flight numbers and booking emails; a friends section with alert switches and a story-sticker maker; a split-flap delay board; reviews and a device composition — plus Pricing (rolling prices, sticky comparison, a gift-card builder), Passport (one year switch driving a sticky route atlas, charts and a share card), About (sticky story chapters, team, live office clocks) and a live brand guide.
designedFor: Consumer apps, travel and mobility products that want to show the app working, not screenshots of it
Story-led landing pages with sticky, scroll-driven chapters and a day-to-night colour change
Interactive phone, laptop, tablet and watch mockups drawn in CSS and SVG with real maps
Seeing scroll-pinned stages, live maps and hidden states built as editor-controllable components
